Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on a 
monthly bases as 
indicated by M1 in the title block
The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Gamal Elsyed 
Osily, reviewed by maintenance manager eng. Sobhey Abdel Haleem, approved by 
eng. Mohamed Abdel Khaffar: general manager of Al-Arish power station.
This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector
Technical Data
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution mark surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves ... etc
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tools set
Cleaning fluid, feeler gauge
Complete maintenance tools set
Cleaning fluid, feeler gauge
Work to be Carried Out
Check the oil level of the:
 * Main drive gear reducer
 * Guide bearing
 * Support baring
Check the oil level of the:
 * Main drive gear reducer
 * Guide bearing
 * Support baring
Check oil leakage:
 * Around bearing oil drain plugs, instrument 
 connection etc...
 * In oil piping
 * Around main drive gear reducer drain plugs, 
 dipstick connection ... etc
Check mounting and attachment bolts in drive unit, bearing, etc ... are 
 not loose
Be sure there is no cooling water leakage in oil of bearing
Be sure there is no abnormal noise or vibration
Be sure there is no air or flue gases leakage from manholes
Check the state of heating insulation around the air pre heater
Check clearance and compare from seal clearance chart fig (1)
